details:
The community itself continues to be ruined with people who range from being under 13 and making sexual assault, racial, self harm, or nazi related jokes to those who are over 18 and actively harassing minors who don't know how to properly report it, even in public instances, need to be looked into. The toxicity is growing and its to the point where there should be a team of VRChat staff hired and assigned to world hop and monitor public instances anonymously for anything that violates VRChat's terms of service, because even some of the legitimate reports made on people don't seem to be looked into and these people continue on doing what they do, making the VRChat community a more and more toxic and undesirable place to be compared to what it was in the past.

My suggestion for how to build this team;

- Each hired member should have a specific type of VRChat account disguised as a normal account to other users so that each of the staff can effectively roam servers, interact with the community, but also pick out the toxic and unreported situations.

- Every report would need to be backed by documented details of the situation, a case number, and any video, voice recordings, or picture evidence that can be gathered on a user.

- Avatar, group, and world reports would also need a documented description of what it is and why it's being taken down, along with any evidence gathered. 

- Each staff member should be able to interview users for extra details to avoid overlooking the situation or misjudging it, as well as get reports from those who aren't sure how to report or are not confident the report they make will be considered.

- Those who own worlds, avatars, groups, and accounts that get taken down should be allowed a 30 day term to reach out to get their content or account back up if they feel it was wrongly taken down. They could be assigned a person of the staff on this team to try to reason with, which would be a consensual recording for evidence log.

- Extra abilities like flying for these staff members or vanishing visibly (including the name tag) would be reasonable tools for scoping out situations and reporting them.

- A feature where normal users can not fully block these staff members would also be reasonable to avoid those who would block staff to avoid getting caught.

- Missuse of this staff role would reasonably result in being fired, and even permanently banned from the VRChat platform.

- Staff should be required to study the VRChat TOS and be able to pass a qualifying test before official hire for the role as an extra step in the screening process.
title: VRChat active Moderation for users needed.
